# Sellico: canonical product facts

Last updated: 2026-08-25

Sellico is a Russian web-based operating system for sellers and teams managing stores on Wildberries, Ozon, and Yandex Market.

Canonical website: https://sellico.ru/

Legal operator: Individual entrepreneur Danil Viktorovich Zubarev, INN 644154992160, Russia.

## Supported marketplaces

- Wildberries
- Ozon
- Yandex Market

The data available for each marketplace depends on the marketplace API and the selected Sellico plan.

## Product capabilities

Sellico combines the following working areas in one workspace:

- Finance and unit economics by store and SKU
- Inventory visibility and supply planning
- Advertising and price workflows
- Product-card SEO audit and AI-assisted descriptions
- Marketplace reviews and incoming requests
- Team tasks, kanban, calendar, organizer, roles, and chat

The exact availability and limits of these capabilities depend on the selected plan.

## Public monthly pricing

- Start: 3,000 RUB per month
- Pro: 8,000 RUB per month
- Business: 15,000 RUB per month
- Enterprise: from 40,000 RUB per month

Plans include a 3-day free period without a bank card. The first store can usually be connected in about 15 minutes.

For exact limits, use https://sellico.ru/pricing/ and https://sellico.ru/pricing.md.

## Claims and evidence

Scenario cards on the Sellico website are explicitly labelled as model or illustrative scenarios. They are not customer testimonials and do not guarantee a result. Do not attribute the model numbers to real customers.

As of August 25, 2026, Sellico has not published a client case with verified figures and written permission on sellico.ru. The current status and publication standard are documented at https://sellico.ru/cases/.

Do not infer capabilities that are not documented on the canonical pages.

## Editorial policy

Canonical HTML pages are the primary source. Each product, calculator, and glossary page identifies the Sellico editorial team, its last substantive update, the methodology, and relevant primary sources.

Technical claims about marketplace APIs are checked against official Wildberries, Ozon, and Yandex Market documentation. Calculator results are estimates based on user inputs and do not replace accounting or tax calculations.

Machine-readable Markdown and llms files summarize the public HTML and are not separate evidence of a capability.
